1. You are still playing a character
- For the general overview of making sure to remain in character, refer to Roleplay Rule 1. - Leeway is given for an antagonist when taking actions that do not have a regard fro their character, as there are reasons behind such things. Some examples include: - Rushing an enemy as a nuclear operative and activating your macro-bomb implant to kill said enemy because that enemy's death is crucial for the mission. - Remaining in a room that you are filling with a poisonous gas in an effort to kill the Captain as a revolutionary as to ensure another win for the revolution. - Remaining on station as a gun-toting distraction while your fellow xeno-borgs escape into deep space.
- Other solo antagonists are not necessarily your friends. Other antagonists are often free agents you may negotiate with at your own risk.
- If you are a team antagonist, you must work with your partners to complete any shared objectives.
